normal.name: The Boss Rush Network
normal.text: What happens when a game disappears from every store? 🎮 In this clip from the Boss Rush Podcast, Corey Dirrig, LeRon Dawkins, and Andre Wilson discuss how players can help preserve games that are no longer legally available for purchase. From emulation to tracking down who owns the rights, keeping gaming history alive may depend on fans, storefronts, and lawyers working together. #BossRushPodcast #GamePreservation #RetroGaming #Emulation #GamingNews
